summary_short: Krishna explains the imperishable Brahman, the nature of death, remembrance, and the paths after death.
summary_medium: Arjuna asks about Brahman, karma, the self, and what happens at the time of death. Krishna explains how remembrance at the final moment shapes the soul’s journey and reveals the two eternal paths after death.
summary_detailed: Definitions of Brahman, Adhyatma, Karma, and Adhibhuta.
Practice throughout life determines final state.
The bright and dark paths after death.
what_you_learn: What happens at the moment of death.
Why fear at death can be overcome.
How memory shapes rebirth or liberation.
Difference between temporary and eternal paths.
